definition: dark makeup brushed onto the eyelashes
description: At a lit vanity mirror, a young woman pulls the wand out of a black mascara tube and brushes it onto her lashes with her mouth wide open the whole time, the funny face everyone makes. Her friend watches behind her, she fixes a smudge with a cotton swab and admires her lashes.
transcript: The face, everyone does it. Hello. (gasps)
